title: Education
description: Represents an academic qualification, educational program, or course of study.

degree.title: Degree
degree.description: The name or type of degree, qualification, or program completed or pursued.

institution.title: Institution
institution.description: The school, university, college, or other educational institution attended.

institutionUrl.title: Institution URL
institutionUrl.description: A URI linking to the website of the educational institution. Null indicates that no URL is available.

location.title: Location
location.description: The city, region, or country where the educational institution or program is located.

startDate.title: Start Date
startDate.description: The year or month in which the education began, using YYYY or YYYY-MM format.

startLabel.title: Start Date Label
startLabel.description: The human-readable label used to display the education start date.

endDate.title: End Date
endDate.description: The year or month in which the education ended, using YYYY or YYYY-MM format. Null indicates that the education is ongoing.

endLabel.title: End Date Label
endLabel.description: The human-readable label used to display the education end date. Null indicates that the education is ongoing.

current.title: Currently Enrolled
current.description: Indicates whether the individual is currently enrolled in the education program.

thesis.title: Thesis
thesis.description: The title or description of the thesis, dissertation, or major academic research project. Null indicates that the program did not involve a thesis.

description.title: Description
description.description: Additional information about the education, program, academic focus, or achievements.

highlights.title: Highlights
highlights.description: A list of notable achievements, activities, distinctions, or outcomes associated with the education.

items.description: A notable achievement, activity, distinction, or outcome.

courses.title: Courses
courses.description: A list of relevant academic courses associated with the education.

course.title: Course
course.description: Represents an academic course and its associated information.

code.title: Course Code
code.description: The official course code or identifier, such as APMA E2000 or FREN UN1101.

title.title: Course Title
title.description: The official title or name of the course.

professor.title: Professor
professor.description: The name of the professor or instructor who taught the course.

date.title: Course Date
date.description: The year or date associated with the course, using YYYY or the ISO 8601 calendar date format YYYY-MM-DD.

enrollmentType.title: Enrollment Type
enrollmentType.description: The enrollment/participation type for the course.

syllabus.title: Syllabus
syllabus.description: A URL pointing to the course syllabus.

description.title: Course Description
description.description: A summary of the course content.
